title: Memory Maps, Reference Manuals & Registers
blurb: Microcontroller architecture, the STM32 address space, reading a reference manual, and your first GPIO registers (MODER, OTYPER, PUPDR, IDR, ODR).

title: Interrupts
blurb: Why polling doesn't scale, how the NVIC and vector table work, and wiring GPIO to the CPU with EXTI — registers, triggers, and a button-driven register playground.

title: Timers
blurb: Hardware timers from first principles: PSC/ARR maths, interrupt-driven blinking, button debouncing, and a full register quick-reference.

title: Capture/Compare & PWM
blurb: How a timer's Capture/Compare module measures real-world timing and generates precisely-timed signals — the basis for PWM, motor control, and LEDs.

title: Serial Communication (UART)
blurb: How two chips with no shared clock hold a reliable conversation over a single wire, one bit at a time — UART framing, baud rate, and every register bit explained.
